The structure of Mg12Fe2Ni2 (Mg6FeNi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Fe, Mg, and Ni centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each. The 12-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra display corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, while Fe–Mg and Mg–Ni polyhedra show corner- and edge-sharing; the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites.
